bullets.title: Joyful Wisdom: Embracing Change and Finding Freedom
bullets.creator: Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche
bullets.note: . This book was first recommended to me by the phenom that is [Safi Bahcall](https://tim.blog/2019/08/16/safi-bahcall/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), a former physicist and founder of a publicly-traded biotech company, who also knows hypnotism and a dozen other fields inside and out. It took me more than a year to dig into _Joyful Wisdom_, as I was turned off by the title. I expected another rinse and repeat of the usual Buddhist bag o’ tricks, which have never quite clicked for me. Much to my surprise, I quickly found insights, analogies, and practices that \*did\* stick in the first 100 pages.

bullets.section: What I’m using twice a week —
bullets.title: Hand balance boards for handstands and hand balancing
bullets.note: ([here’s their site](https://beyond-balance.net/products/balance-board) if Amazon sells out). I’ve been getting back into spending time upside down. Specifically, I’m working on hand balancing. For a glimpse of mutant abilities and inspiration, check out [Andrii Bondarenko](https://www.instagram.com/andrii_bondarenko/feed/). For an easier starting point, or to save your wrists, check out the [FeetUp trainer](https://feetup.com/products/feetup-trainer-classic-white). Are you a pro? I’d love your top 2–3 training tips! Please let me know at [@tferriss on Twitter](https://twitter.com/tferriss) and **add #handstands** so I can find you.

bullets.section: Science and big news that I’m thrilled about —
bullets.title: published this week
bullets.note:
was [published this week](https://www.hopkinsmedicine.org/news/newsroom/news-releases/psychedelic-treatment-with-psilocybin-relieves-major-depression-study-shows) in _JAMA Psychiatry_ ([@JAMAPsych](https://twitter.com/JAMAPsych)), and it doesn’t disappoint. ⁣Here are a few eye-opening highlights:⁣ ⁣  
  
_“The magnitude of the effect we saw was about_ **_four times larger than what clinical trials have shown for traditional antidepressants on the market_**_,” says Alan Davis, Ph.D.⁣  
  
_\[...\]⁣  
  
_For the entire group of 24 participants, 67% showed a more than 50% reduction in depression symptoms at the one-week follow-up and 71% at the four-week follow-up._ **_Overall, four weeks post-treatment, 54% of participants were considered in remission – meaning they no longer qualified as being depressed.  
  
_**Huge congratulations to the entire team at the [Johns Hopkins Psychedelic Research Center](https://hopkinspsychedelic.org/) ([@JHPsychedelics](https://twitter.com/JHPsychedelics)). I believe this study to be a critically important proof of concept for the medical approval of psilocybin for treatment of depression, a condition I have personally struggled with for decades.⁣  
  
Special thanks to everyone who supported this study in the earliest stages, including [Cody Swift](https://www.riverstyxfoundation.org/staff) ([RiverStyx Foundation](https://www.riverstyxfoundation.org/)), [Dave Morin](https://twitter.com/davemorin) ([Sunrise Foundation](https://www.sunrise.bio/)), and [all of the superstars](https://web.archive.org/web/20190803211230/http://crowdrise.com/timferriss) who participated in the [CrowdRise fundraiser](https://web.archive.org/web/20190803211230/http://crowdrise.com/timferriss) (now GoFundMe) so long ago.It’s been a huge week in psychedelic developments nationwide, especially in Oregon. Read more here:  
[Oregon becomes first state to legalize magic mushrooms as more states ease drug laws in ‘psychedelic renaissance’](https://www.cnbc.com/2020/11/04/oregon-becomes-first-state-to-legalize-magic-mushrooms-as-more-states-ease-drug-laws.html) (CNBC)  
[Oregon just voted to legalize magic mushrooms. Here’s what that actually means.](https://www.popsci.com/story/health/psilocybin-magic-mushroom-legal/) (_Popular Science)  
_[Oregon Just Became the First State to Legalize Access to Magic Mushrooms](https://www.motherjones.com/2020-elections/2020/11/oregon-legalize-magic-mushrooms-psilocybin-measure-109/) (_Mother Jones)_  
Kudos to all Oregonians who supported this, as well as early financial and strategic supporters, including [David Bronner](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Bronner), his family, and [Dr. Bronner’s](https://twitter.com/DrBronner); [Graham Boyd](https://psfc.co/board-of-directors) and [PSFC](https://psfc.co/); and many others who played pivotal roles.
